name: dslab
description: Interactive data-structure simulator: a C++17 engine compiled to WebAssembly, drawn with React and SVG.

scripts.test:cpp: cmake --preset native && cmake --build --preset native && ctest --preset native
scripts.test:cpp:asan: cmake --preset asan && cmake --build --preset asan && ctest --preset asan
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && cmake --preset native && cmake --build --preset native --target dslab_cli && playwright test
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
